dex.entry: A small glinting schooling fish with a single prismatic scale that acts like a signal mirror. Groups of them communicate with flashes. Cute little mirror-fish — the tutorial kin for Tide typing; appears in water as soon as the player gets Tidecall.

art.silhouette: Tiny silvery fish with oversized prism-scale fin fanning out like a tail-fan, blue-teal body, big friendly eye, subtle light-refracting markings.
